question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

To run oneself down
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To run oneself down"** means to undervalue or criticize one’s own abilities or achievements. (अपने कौशल या उपलब्धियों को कम आंकना या उनकी आलोचना करना) • **Example:** She often runs herself down by saying she's not capable of handling big responsibilities, even though she’s excellent at her job. • Here, the phrase implies belittling oneself or making oneself appear less capable than one truly is. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Excessive self-praise** (अत्यधिक आत्म-प्रशंसा): Talking too much about one's own qualities or achievements in an exaggerated way. • **Example:** His excessive self-praise made it difficult for people to believe his claims. • **Option 2: Making fun of others** (दूसरों का मजाक उड़ाना): Ridiculing or mocking someone. • **Example:** It’s not polite to make fun of others for their mistakes. • **Option 3: Remaining silent about success** (सफलता के बारे में चुप रहना): Choosing not to talk about one’s achievements. • **Example:** He remained silent about his success because he didn’t want to boast. 33:Ta00, The correct answer is: **Pacifist**.
